title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Cuts that landed on the wrong lines
summary: The workspace sweep measured its cuts on one text and applied them to another, and a diff view made three commands read HEAD while writing the working file.

highlights.title: The workspace sweep cuts where it measured
highlights.description: It swept the disk, re converted its offsets against a second read, then applied the result to the open document. One line added above and every cut in that file moved down, silently. A file whose text moved since the scan is now left alone and says so.

highlights.title: A diff view is not the file
highlights.description: A comparison opens a document whose scheme is `git:` and whose path is the real file path. Three commands recognised it by path alone and read HEAD while writing the working file.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Clean Dead Code in Workspace measured its offsets on the disk, converted them against a second read, and applied them to the open buffer. Written down as a test: a cut aimed at line 4 landed on line 1, inside the package declaration.
Remove Code Used Only by Tests, Make Every Self Only Member Private and the unused symbol removals all took a `git:` diff document for the file itself.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The VS Code test double kept the scheme inside the parsed path, which made a diff document distinguishable in a test while it is indistinguishable in reality.
